title: Skill++: Towards Lifelong Agents via Routing-Aware Skill Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.00544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents extend their capabilities with skills, each with a name, a description, and a body. Under progressive disclosure, an LLM router selects skills by name and description alone and loads only the selected bodies. Skill libraries grow continually as users and agents add new skills. Because the router relies on this metadata, a similar new skill can displace an earlier one, breaking previously correct routing even though the earlier skill and the router are unchanged. This routing interference is aggravated for public skills, whose descriptions may not match their bodies. We formulate the problem as lifelong skill routing, a class-incremental continual learning problem. A solution must keep earlier skills selectable without suppressing new ones. translated_title: Skill++：通过路由感知的技能精炼迈向终身智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过技能来扩展自身能力，每个技能包含名称、描述和内容本体。在渐进式披露机制下，LLM路由器仅根据名称和描述来选择技能，并只加载被选中技能的内容本体。随着用户和智能体不断添加新技能，技能库会持续增长。由于路由器依赖这些元数据，一个相似的新技能可能会取代较早的技能，即使较早的技能和路由器本身都没有任何改变，之前正确的路由也会被破坏。对于公开技能而言，这种路由干扰会进一步加剧，因为其描述可能与内容本体不匹配。我们将该问题形式化为终身技能路由，这是一类类增量式持续学习问题。解决方案必须保证较早的技能仍然可选，同时不抑制新技能。现有方法均存在不足：持续重新训练路由器存在灾难性遗忘的风险，而重写方法要么忽略相似技能，要么需要
tldr: 该论文提出Skill++，将技能库增长中相似新技能取代旧技能导致的路由干扰问题形式化为终身技能路由（类增量持续学习）问题，并通过路由感知的技能精炼方法，在保持旧技能仍可被选中的同时避免抑制新技能。
en_tdlr: Skill++ formulates routing interference—where similar new skills displace earlier ones in growing skill libraries—as lifelong skill routing (a class-incremental continual learning problem) and proposes routing-aware skill refinement to keep earlier skills selectable without suppressing new ones.
